method.method_draft: First read the picture as a stack of five equal squares: the exposed top surfaces show 5 at the lower right, 2 at the lower left, 3 as a central horizontal white band, 1 at the upper left, and 4 at the upper right. Simulate physically collecting the stack by repeatedly removing the currently topmost card. The dark card 5 has no other card visibly covering its exposed part and its edges lie over the neighboring lower cards, so remove 5 first. After imagining 5 removed, the gray card 2 would be the next exposed card over the lower part of card 3, so remove 2 second. Then the white card 3, previously partly hidden by 2 and 5, is above the upper cards 1 and 4, so remove 3 third. With 3 gone, the top-left gray card 1 is seen as lying over card 4, so remove 1 fourth. Card 4 remains last. The order is therefore 5-2-3-1-4.
